claims.rationale: Distinct named Kobe machine, no matched existing record. TOP500 system 177232 list history reports June 2011 8,162 TFlop/s and November 10,510 TFlop/s; RIKEN 2011-11-02 announcement documents 10.51 PFlop/s with 88,128 CPUs. RIKEN AICS Number of Jobs FY2012 explicitly dates shared access 2012-09-28; R-CCS Mission complete notice dates end of service 2019-08-16, distinguishing later shutdown. Date of measurement is not inferred from listing date. Benchmark measure is Rmax.

Distinct Fujitsu interconnect improvement and deployment, not the whole FX100. Original Ajima HOTI 2014 slides 1 and 4–7 give dated design, six-dimensional network and on-chip integration. NIFS 2015-06-01 announcement reports operation of its FX100 Plasma Simulator at Toki; TOP500 system 178553 identifies Tofu2. Candidate adapts link points to K with a bounded question; independent informative support for exact inheritance remains open.

Distinct Kobe system. RIKEN shared-use notice 2021-03-09 dates April 2020 trial and shared use March 9; Dongarra pp. 1–2 notes earlier user access in Q1 without activities, now qualified. TOP500 system 179807 June/November 2020 rows and RIKEN Nov 2020 announcement distinguish historical measured HPL from peak. RIKEN 17 Nov 2026 notice timeline and future actions dates 14 Nov suspension with planned resumption after remediation, not permanent closure. The Tofu2 link remains candidate; Fujitsu FX1000 white paper p.7 gives developer account but Dongarra pp.7–8 closely tracks the 2018 developer text and does not independently establish inheritance.

Inventory distinguishes Fugaku suspension, JUPITER Booster access and FugakuNEXT plan. Jülich 17 Nov 2026 operator article reports allocated projects and research, JUPITER user documentation warns of early access, and TOP500 listing describes measured rank; no claim of general production. RIKEN 29 May 2026 basic-design notice and project page support FugakuNEXT as proposed. Jülich technical overview identifies alternative InfiniBand and DragonFly+; frontier retains unverified production and restart. Historical directional links explicitly candidate.

Compared source and research-note metadata with original designer slides, Fujitsu 2018 paper and FX1000 white paper, Dongarra report, RIKEN operator announcements and TOP500 records, NIFS 2015 announcement; notes retain source provenance and distinguish theoretical and measured results. The Jülich 17 November primary HTML was inspected directly via curl.

corrections: Changed both originally established interconnect links to candidate; removed derived origin and described Dongarra text dependence.
Replaced inaccessible ISC deck with directly inspected dated HOTI original.
Changed June benchmark events to reporting dates and qualified earlier access evidence.
deferred: Independent informative corroboration of the exact Tofu design inheritance, JUPITER transition to general production, and verified Fugaku resumption.
